title: Cancel For Any Reason Terms across the Trip Protection Plans
content:
Cancel For Any Reason (CFAR) cover is set by three terms on each Trip Protection plan: the CFAR reimbursement percentage, the CFAR purchase window and the CFAR cancellation cutoff. A plan that does not offer CFAR shows 0.00 or 0 for all three.

## CFAR schedule

| Plan | CFAR reimbursement (percent of the non-refunded insured cost) | CFAR purchase window (calendar days after the stay was booked) | CFAR cancellation cutoff (elapsed hours before the start of the check-in date) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Trip Cancellation Only | 0.00 | 0 | 0 |
| Trip Protection Essential | 0.00 | 0 | 0 |
| Trip Protection Standard | 0.00 | 0 | 0 |
| Trip Protection Plus | 0.00 | 0 | 0 |
| Trip Protection Premier | 0.00 | 0 | 0 |
| Trip Protection Premier CFAR | 75.00 | 14 | 48 |

## Meaning of each term

- **CFAR reimbursement percentage**: the percentage of the non-refunded insured cost paid on a cancel-for-any-reason claim; 0.00 where CFAR is not offered.
- **CFAR purchase window**: the number of calendar days after the stay was booked within which the CFAR plan must be bought; 0 where CFAR is not offered.
- **CFAR cancellation cutoff**: the number of elapsed hours before the start of the check-in date by which a CFAR cancellation must be made; 0 where CFAR is not offered.

## Points of judgement

- Only Trip Protection Premier CFAR shows a CFAR reimbursement percentage above 0.00; the other five plans show 0.00, 0 and 0 and do not offer CFAR.
- Trip Protection Premier CFAR is bought within 14 days of booking and insures the full stay total price.
- On Trip Protection Premier CFAR the three figures read together as 75.00 percent, a 14-day purchase window and a 48-hour cutoff.
